finding.rationale: Enumeration of the Intune-managed device inventory via GET /deviceManagement/managedDevices reveals OS versions, compliance state, encryption status, and enrollment dates across the fleet. An adversary can use this data to identify non-compliant or unencrypted endpoints as lateral movement targets, correlate device ownership to high-value user accounts, and infer last-sync timestamps to time activity around stale device policies. DeviceManagementManagedDevices.Read.All is an Intune-admin-class scope; the accounts that hold it should be limited to device management staff and audited for unexpected additions.
